entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt:
SIDE CHAT / FEATURE BRANCH — Login only. Do NOT rewrite dashboard, transactions, statements, categories, serviceability, shared sidebar chrome, or existing chart JS.

Goal: add a login prototype that matches the existing visual system in this project (warm paper / modern-minimal tokens in css/shared.css — IBM Plex Sans+Mono, hairline borders, single blue accent, no purple glass).

Create NEW files only:
1. `funds-login.html` — full-bleed auth screen (NO app sidebar). Brand FUNDS hero-level. Email + password fields, Show/hide password, Remember me, Sign in CTA, Forgot password link, subtle error + loading states (can be demo toggles or buttons). Optional: link “Continue to app →” that goes to funds-dashboard.html for prototype flow.
2. Optionally extend `index.html` with ONE new card/link to the login prototype — do not remove existing links or rewrite the notes sections beyond adding that link.

Behaviour notes (prototype, not real auth):
- Form validates empty fields with inline errors
- Fake sign-in: after submit show brief loading then success toast / redirect hint to dashboard
- Mobile-friendly single column; desktop can be split composition if tasteful (brand panel + form) but keep one clear composition, not a dashboard

Reuse css/shared.css tokens/classes where they fit; add a small `css/login.css` only if needed for auth-layout specifics.

Keep IA of the main app untouched otherwise.
